question: What did bringing grunge to the catwalk in 1992 cost the designer Marc Jacobs?
answer: His job. His spring 1993 collection for Perry Ellis, shown in late 1992, remade thrift-shop flannel shirts and floral dresses in costly fabrics. Buyers and critics balked, and the company dismissed him. Years later the show was treated as prophetic; in 2018 he reissued the collection under his own name.
move: Being early looks exactly like being wrong until the calendar catches up.
reference: Valerie Steele, Fifty Years of Fashion: New Look to Now, Yale University Press, 1997
